_readme:
All Spanish/English text for index.html and the shared menu/footer. Each key is one piece of text: "es" is the Spanish (default) version, "en" the English one. An empty "en" means that text stays in Spanish for English visitors. The site loads this file on every visit and it overrides whatever text is in index.html, so translations survive even if index.html is overwritten. The editor rewrites this file on every Save. You can also edit it by hand: keep the quotes and commas intact, and use
for line breaks.

home.band-title.es:
Desde el rodaje a la edición,
y todo lo que hay en medio
home.band-title.en:
From shooting to editing,
and everything in between.

home.band-text.es: La mayoría de lo que hago surge como una excusa para tomar la cámara, y luego se transforma en algo de lo que no puedo parar de hablar.
home.band-text.en: Most of what I create starts as an excuse to grab a camera, then it turns into something I want to keep telling people about.

home.sayhi-text.es: Abierto a trabajo freelance, colaboraciones y a cualquiera que quiera hablar sobre cámaras, ecosistemas y muchos otros temas.
home.sayhi-text.en: Open to freelance work, collaborations, and anyone who wants to talk about cameras, ecosystems and a bunch of other stuff.
